title: Toad in the Hole with British Twist
description: A classic British dish with a rich and dense flavor, featuring sausages cooked in a Yorkshire pudding batter.

ingredients.name: Yorkshire pudding mix
ingredients.notes: Make sure it's a British-style mix

ingredients.name: Milk
ingredients.notes: Use whole milk for a richer flavor

ingredients.name: Eggs
ingredients.notes: Large eggs work best for this recipe

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.notes: Use a flaky sea salt for added flavor

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the milk, eggs, and Yorkshire pudding mix.
Add the flour and salt to the bowl and whisk until smooth.
Pour the batter into a greased 9x13-inch baking dish.
Cook the sausages in a large skillet over medium-high heat until browned on all sides.
Remove the sausages from the skillet and place them in the baking dish with the batter.
Pour the remaining batter over the sausages, making sure they're fully covered.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the Yorkshire pudding is golden brown and puffed.
Serve the Toad in the Hole hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
